overlay.hidden_orders_repo.py:
import unittest
from shop.repo.orders_repo import OrdersRepo


class HiddenOrdersRepoTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_get(self):
        r = OrdersRepo()
        r.add({"id": "o1", "total": 5})
        self.assertEqual(r.get("o1")["total"], 5)

    def test_duplicate_raises_keyerror(self):
        r = OrdersRepo()
        r.add({"id": "o1"})
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            r.add({"id": "o1"})

    def test_list_sorted_by_id(self):
        r = OrdersRepo()
        r.add({"id": "b"})
        r.add({"id": "a"})
        self.assertEqual([o["id"] for o in r.list()], ["a", "b"])

    def test_delete_then_get_raises(self):
        r = OrdersRepo()
        r.add({"id": "o1"})
        r.delete("o1")
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            r.get("o1")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
